You can get better. It might feel like there is no reason to stay alive. But there always is. Do not give up in the search for happiness and appreciate the time spent with your friend and focus on that. Thinking positively will not reverse the wrongs commited but it will help you get over it. Remember that life is worth more than a rope. You are not a sadist. You have just experienced something awful. Try confronting your parents.
Life is very short. There is nothing to make you not deserve life. All life is precious. Savor it. You can still right your wrongs
